name: Hair by Shauna Boo
description: Hair by Shauna Boo is a glam hair studio for cuts, bouncy blowouts and curls, silk presses, and fun color like peekaboo highlights — pretty, polished hair with a little extra sparkle.

hero.title: Glam hair, Shauna Boo style.
hero.subtitle: Cuts, bouncy blowouts, silk presses, and fun color from peekaboos to all-over shades — book your glam with Shauna today.

stylists.name: Mz Shauna Boo
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Mz Shauna Boo is the stylist behind Hair by Shauna Boo. She loves glam blowouts, bouncy curls, and fun color — from soft peekaboo highlights to bold all-over shades — and makes every client feel pretty, polished, and confident.

reviews.name: Alexis R.
reviews.text: Shauna did my peekaboo highlights and I'm obsessed! The color is so vibrant and my hair still feels soft.

reviews.name: Jasmine C.
reviews.text: Best blowout ever — so bouncy and full. I felt like a whole new person.

reviews.name: Destiny M.
reviews.text: Sweet, talented, and always on time. My silk press lasted almost two weeks!

reviews.name: Kayla P.
reviews.text: Love the vibe and love my cut. Shauna Boo is my go-to from now on.
